mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_snapshot_group (group_name, snapshot_date, status, checksum, created_by, published_at) VALUES (#{groupName}, #{snapshotDate}, 'PUBLISHED', #{checksum}, #{createdBy}, NOW(3))
INSERT INTO inventory_snapshot_group_member (group_id, warehouse_code, inventory_snapshot_id) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{inventorySnapshotId})
mapper.select: SELECT inventory_snapshot_id FROM inventory_snapshot_group_member WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND warehouse_code=#{warehouseCode}
